versions.changelog:
Initial release of zhz-subtitle: audio transcription and bilingual subtitle generator.

- Generates transcripts and bilingual (Chinese/English) SRT subtitles for audio/video files.
- Supports trigger words: 转录, transcribe, 语音转文字, 字幕, subtitle, 双语字幕.
- Provides two workflows: audio-to-text only, or full bilingual subtitle generation.
- Flexible options for model size, input language, subtitle order, and audio-only mode.
- Handles all ffmpeg-supported audio/video formats and automates environment setup.
- Ensures high subtitle quality with validation, number-handling, and batch translation for long files.
